tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: Page White / Night Page. The page ground, and the fill of controls that sit on a tray (`surface`).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Tray Grey / Night Tray. Every resting card, and the fill of inputs and controls that sit on `page` or `raised`.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Ground of floating panels: popover, menu, dialog, sheet, toast. Always with `shadow-float`. Added for overlays; the source page had none.

tokens.name: inverse
tokens.usage: The one ink card that may anchor a group. Text on it is `on-inverse`, secondary text `on-dark-soft` and `on-dark-muted`.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one loud colour: the primary action, and at most one large surface per screen. Tray Yellow in the Light and the Dark theme; every other theme has an accent of its own, always bright enough for ink text. Text on it is `on-accent`.

tokens.name: leaf
tokens.usage: The single surface about where a product comes from. Text on it is `ink`, `ink-soft` or `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: The veil behind a dialog, drawer or sheet. Added for overlays.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on `page`, `surface`, `raised` and `leaf`; selected states; the focus ring. At least 10:1 on each in every theme.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `page`, `surface`, `raised` and `leaf`. At least 6.6:1 in every theme.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions and hints on `page`, `surface`, `raised` and `leaf`. At least 4.5:1 in every theme.

tokens.name: ink-hint
tokens.usage: The lightest text: axis ticks and placeholders on `page`, `surface` and `raised` (4.5:1 or more). Not for text on `leaf` or `inverse`, where it falls below 4.5:1.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: All text and icons on `accent` (12.9:1). Never white.

tokens.name: on-inverse
tokens.usage: Primary text on `inverse` (14:1 or more).

tokens.name: on-dark-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `inverse` (8.5:1 or more).

tokens.name: on-dark-muted
tokens.usage: Axis ticks and captions on `inverse` (5.9:1 or more).

tokens.name: on-dark-danger
tokens.usage: Error text and the danger fill on the ink card, where `danger` is too dark to read.

tokens.name: on-dark-success
tokens.usage: Success text on the ink card, where `success` is too dark to read.

tokens.name: on-dark-code-comment
tokens.usage: Comments, in a code block on the ink card.

tokens.name: on-dark-code-keyword
tokens.usage: Keywords and types (`const`, `return`, `<!DOCTYPE>`), in a code block on the ink card.

tokens.name: on-dark-code-string
tokens.usage: Strings, and the values of HTML attributes, in a code block on the ink card.

tokens.name: on-dark-code-function
tokens.usage: The names of functions and classes, in a code block on the ink card.

tokens.name: on-dark-code-tag
tokens.usage: HTML tag names and CSS element selectors, in a code block on the ink card.

tokens.name: on-dark-code-constant
tokens.usage: Attribute names, CSS properties and classes, numbers and literals, in a code block on the ink card.

tokens.name: on-dark-code-variable
tokens.usage: Built-in names (`document`, `console`), in a code block on the ink card.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a `danger` fill, such as the destructive button (6.5:1 light, 8.3:1 dark). Added for that button.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: The one rule colour: list dividers, table rows, form sections, chart gridlines.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: A chart baseline, and the grip of a resizable split or a drawer. A decorative rule: it does not carry meaning alone.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: The empty part of a meter, slider or progress bar; an inactive status chip; a skeleton.

tokens.name: control-off
tokens.usage: An unselected radio ring or checkbox edge, and an off switch, on `page` and `surface` (3.1:1 or more). On `raised` it falls to 2.9:1 in the dark theme, so components use `ink-hint` there.

tokens.name: dark-rule
tokens.usage: Gridlines and dividers on `inverse`.

tokens.name: inverse-off
tokens.usage: An inactive mark or chip on `inverse`, with `on-inverse` text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text, the 2px ring of an invalid field, the destructive button. On `page`, `surface` and `raised` (5.9:1 or more). Always with words or an icon.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: A positive change or a finished step, always with words or an icon. On `page`, `surface` and `raised` (6.8:1 or more). The dark value is added; the source had none.

tokens.name: data-1
tokens.usage: First chart series. Data colours are used in this order, belong to a series and never to a rank, and appear nowhere outside charts.

tokens.name: data-2
tokens.usage: Second chart series.

tokens.name: data-3
tokens.usage: Third chart series. Below 3:1 on light grounds, so its marks carry a label or the chart has a table view.

tokens.name: data-4
tokens.usage: Fourth and last chart series. Below 3:1 on light grounds: label it or give the table view. A fifth series folds into Other, drawn in `ink-hint`.

tokens.name: code-comment
tokens.usage: Comments, in a code block on `page` and `surface`. GitHub's syntax colour, tuned to hold 4.5:1 on every ground.

tokens.name: code-keyword
tokens.usage: Keywords and types (`const`, `return`, `<!DOCTYPE>`), in a code block on `page` and `surface`. GitHub's syntax colour, tuned to hold 4.5:1 on every ground.

tokens.name: code-string
tokens.usage: Strings, and the values of HTML attributes, in a code block on `page` and `surface`. GitHub's syntax colour, tuned to hold 4.5:1 on every ground.

tokens.name: code-function
tokens.usage: The names of functions and classes, in a code block on `page` and `surface`. GitHub's syntax colour, tuned to hold 4.5:1 on every ground.

tokens.name: code-tag
tokens.usage: HTML tag names and CSS element selectors, in a code block on `page` and `surface`. GitHub's syntax colour, tuned to hold 4.5:1 on every ground.

tokens.name: code-constant
tokens.usage: Attribute names, CSS properties and classes, numbers and literals, in a code block on `page` and `surface`. GitHub's syntax colour, tuned to hold 4.5:1 on every ground.

tokens.name: code-variable
tokens.usage: Built-in names (`document`, `console`), in a code block on `page` and `surface`. GitHub's syntax colour, tuned to hold 4.5:1 on every ground.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The light `page` under a fixed name: controls on `accent` surfaces and the fills of drawings. Same in every theme.

tokens.name: paper-ink
tokens.usage: The light `ink` under a fixed name: text and strokes on `accent` surfaces and in drawings.

tokens.name: paper-tray
tokens.usage: The light `surface` under a fixed name, on `accent` surfaces.

tokens.name: paper-soft
tokens.usage: The light `ink-soft` under a fixed name. On `accent` prefer `on-accent`.

tokens.name: paper-muted
tokens.usage: The light `ink-muted` under a fixed name.

tokens.name: paper-hairline
tokens.usage: The light `hairline` under a fixed name.

tokens.name: paper-track
tokens.usage: The light `track` under a fixed name; the shaded side of a drawn object.

tokens.name: paper-danger
tokens.usage: Error text and the danger fill on the yellow card, in every theme.

tokens.name: paper-success
tokens.usage: Success text on the yellow card, in every theme.

tokens.name: paper-code-comment
tokens.usage: Comments, in a code block on the yellow card, in every theme.

tokens.name: paper-code-keyword
tokens.usage: Keywords and types (`const`, `return`, `<!DOCTYPE>`), in a code block on the yellow card, in every theme.

tokens.name: paper-code-string
tokens.usage: Strings, and the values of HTML attributes, in a code block on the yellow card, in every theme.

tokens.name: paper-code-function
tokens.usage: The names of functions and classes, in a code block on the yellow card, in every theme.

tokens.name: paper-code-tag
tokens.usage: HTML tag names and CSS element selectors, in a code block on the yellow card, in every theme.

tokens.name: paper-code-constant
tokens.usage: Attribute names, CSS properties and classes, numbers and literals, in a code block on the yellow card, in every theme.

tokens.name: paper-code-variable
tokens.usage: Built-in names (`document`, `console`), in a code block on the yellow card, in every theme.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The page headline, once per page. Fluid: set the size with `display-size` (2.75rem to 6rem).

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Section headings, and the title of a lead card. Fluid: `headline-size` (2.125rem to 4rem).

styles.name: title
styles.usage: The heading inside a large card; a dialog title. Fluid: `title-size` (1.75rem to 2.5rem).

styles.name: subtitle
styles.usage: List items, steps, accordion questions, chart and card titles. Fluid: `subtitle-size` (1.375rem to 1.75rem).

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: One large numeral in a card, its unit set at `title` size on the same baseline. Fluid: `figure-size` (4rem to 7rem).

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Raised, collected by hand and packed on our own farm.
styles.usage: The sentence under a headline, in `ink-soft`, at most 36 characters per line on desktop.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: By day the beds look empty. The snails are there, tucked under the boards.
styles.usage: Everything that explains. Reading columns are 38rem wide.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Courier delivery in a chilled box.
styles.usage: Field hints, chart keys, dates, the second line of a choice or an item.

styles.name: tick
styles.usage: Axis ticks, month cells and labels printed inside a chart mark (weight 600 there).

styles.name: action
styles.usage: The label of a large (64px) button; the title of a small linked card.

styles.name: control
styles.usage: Segments, medium buttons, and the value typed into a field (at weight 400).

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Tabs, menu items, small buttons, table rows.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, chips and badges, table heads. Sentence case, no tracking.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks and inline code. The system stack: no mono face is shipped. Added for Code Block.

styles.name: kbd
styles.usage: A key in a keyboard shortcut.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: The gap between segments, tabs and stepper buttons; the padding of the tray that holds them.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Label to field; icon to text in a small control; between stacked choices.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control to its text (checkbox, radio, avatar); rows of a compact list.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: The grid gap between cards; between fields; icon to label in a large button.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: The padding of an accordion row or a list row.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between a heading and its content inside a card.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Card padding on a phone (the lower end of `card-pad`).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of a large button; between groups inside a card.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Between sections of a form.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Page padding on desktop (the upper end of `page-pad`).

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop (the upper end of `card-pad`).

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between the parts of an empty state; large vertical breathing room inside a card.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, sheets and drawers. Radii step down with nesting.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: A panel inside a card; popovers and hover cards.

tokens.name: radius-button
tokens.usage: Large buttons; the tray of a segmented control, tab strip or stepper; menus.

tokens.name: radius-input
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, textareas, choice cards, medium buttons, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Small buttons, segments, tabs, menu items, calendar days.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Chips, badges, tooltips, extra-small buttons, avatars.

tokens.name: radius-mark
tokens.usage: Chart marks and their key swatches, the checkbox, a key cap.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Meters, sliders and the switch only.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: The only shadow. For things that float above the page: tooltip, popover, menu, dialog, toast. Never on a resting card, button or input.

tokens.name: size-lg
tokens.usage: Height of a large button: the main action of a page or card.

tokens.name: size-md
tokens.usage: Height of inputs, selects, and a medium button that sits in a row with them.

tokens.name: size-segment
tokens.usage: Height of a segment and of a stepper button.

tokens.name: size-sm
tokens.usage: Height of a small button and of the theme switch, in a header or toolbar.

tokens.name: size-hit
tokens.usage: The smallest target for nearly everything: tabs, menu items, calendar days, icon buttons in a row. Smaller, as the accessibility guide says: the 36px nested links of a sidebar, rows of a file tree and labels of folding sections, the 28px Slider, the 16px handle of Resizable.

tokens.name: size-xs
tokens.usage: Height of a chip, and of an extra-small button in a dense toolbar or table.

tokens.name: size-icon
tokens.usage: The icon box. An icon is drawn on Lucide's 24px grid and shown at this size, with a 2px stroke.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: The widest the centred page container gets.

tokens.name: page-pad
tokens.usage: Padding between the viewport edge and the container.

tokens.name: card-pad
tokens.usage: Padding inside every card, dialog and sheet.

tokens.name: section-gap
tokens.usage: The even gap between page sections.

tokens.name: grid-gap
tokens.usage: The gap between cards in a bento row.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: The width of a reading column: about 70 characters of `body`.

tokens.name: display-size
tokens.usage: Font size of `display`.

tokens.name: headline-size
tokens.usage: Font size of `headline`.

tokens.name: title-size
tokens.usage: Font size of `title`.

tokens.name: subtitle-size
tokens.usage: Font size of `subtitle`.

tokens.name: figure-size
tokens.usage: Font size of `figure`.

tokens.name: ease
tokens.usage: The one easing curve, for changes of fill and position, and for everything that appears.

tokens.name: duration-press
tokens.usage: Hover darkening and the press scale of a button.

tokens.name: duration-fill
tokens.usage: A change of fill on state: segment, tab, checkbox, card hover.

tokens.name: duration-move
tokens.usage: Something that travels: the switch knob, the pill of a segment or a tab, a toast.

tokens.name: duration-in
tokens.usage: Something appearing: a menu or popover opening from its trigger, a dialog, sheet or drawer coming in, a tooltip, a toast.

tokens.name: duration-out
tokens.usage: The same things going away: always quicker than they came, so a closed thing is out of the way at once.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: The curve of going away: it starts slowly and leaves fast.

tokens.name: ease-spring
tokens.usage: A small overshoot for a thing that answers in place: a count that bumps, a word or a tick that pops in.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: The pinned header.

tokens.name: z-float
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, tooltips.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim, dialog, drawer, sheet.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts, above everything.

tokens.name: bp-phone
tokens.usage: Below this, segmented controls stack their labels and chart labels grow.

tokens.name: bp-tablet
tokens.usage: From here, fields and choices sit two to a row.

tokens.name: bp-bento
tokens.usage: From here, cards take unequal widths in a row; below, every card is full width.

tokens.name: bp-header
tokens.usage: From here, the header is one row; below, the tab strip takes a second, pinned row.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: A disabled control, with `cursor: not-allowed`. Disabled controls keep their fill.
